# Devpost

> Devpost is the world's leading hackathon platform for discovering, hosting, and managing innovation events across public, enterprise, and AI-focused initiatives.

Devpost serves 4M+ developers globally and hosts 80% of the world's AI hackathon events. The platform enables organizations to run public hackathons, internal innovation competitions, and customer engagement programs while providing developers with a showcase for their projects and skills.

## Hackathon Solutions

- [Host public hackathons to grow your developer ecosystem | Devpost](https://info.devpost.com/product/public-hackathons): Host public hackathons on Devpost to engage 4M+ developers globally
- [AI Hackathons: The Platform for Your AI Transformation | Devpost](https://info.devpost.com/product/ai-hackathons): Run AI hackathons on platform used for 80% of world's AI events
- [Innovation Hackathon Platform for AI Adoption | Devpost for Teams](https://info.devpost.com/product/devpost-for-teams): Enterprise platform for secure internal and customer hackathons
- [Customer Hackathons for Product Adoption | Devpost for Teams](https://info.devpost.com/product/customer-hackathons): Private customer hackathons to drive AI tool adoption and engagement
